# Modifiers

8 entries in this folder and its subfolders.

Append compatible instructions to a concrete task. They do not define a task by themselves.

[Full catalog](../CATALOG.md) · [Choosing a prompt](../docs/choosing-a-prompt.md)

| Entry | Use it to | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Exact Output Format](exact-output-format.md) | Use when you need the agent to return exactly the requested format with no extra commentary | modifier |
| [Implementation-Ready Output](implementation-ready-output.md) | Use when you need exact code, files, patches, steps, or validation checks instead of vague advice | modifier |
| [Minimal Scope Change](minimal-scope-change.md) | Use when the agent keeps changing unrelated code, styling, or behavior | modifier |
| [No Invention](no-invention.md) | Use when the agent must not make up claims, prices, features, APIs, or behavior | modifier |
| [Preserve Existing System](preserve-existing-system.md) | Use when the agent must fix or improve something without changing the surrounding system | modifier |
| [Rigorous Agent Execution](rigorous-agent-execution.md) | Use when you want the agent to slow down, inspect carefully, avoid assumptions, and return accurate implementation-ready work | modifier |
| [Safe File Editing](safe-file-editing.md) | Use when the agent edits project files and must not break or overwrite unrelated content | modifier |
| [Verify Before Returning](verify-before-returning.md) | Use when the agent should check its own work before returning it | modifier |
